about: Facet Floor plans foundation (first piece, 2026-10-24: the Vacuum's Map view), the single source for how a floor plan is drawn (build.sh: tools/gen_floorplan.mjs -> floorplan_gen.h fw::fp::; component iso_floorplan). A plan = rooms as polygons in metres (data, never code: a spec parameter), drawn in true isometric as raised tiles with a low back wall, the dolls-house cutaway the panel lab approved. On a panel the plan is ONE pre-rendered image per theme; only the robot is a small sprite moved by an animation, so a move redraws two small boxes, never the plan.

rules.title: Rooms are data
rules.about: Each room is a polygon in metres (plan x right, z down, origin = the inside rear-left corner), a name, an optional cleaning segment and an optional label point. A screen passes them in; the drawing never changes in code for a new house.

rules.title: True isometric, fitted
rules.about: x and z go off at 30 degrees, heights straight up. The scale is the largest that fits the whole house in the box, so the plan never moves when a room is picked or the robot drives.

rules.title: Raised tiles, a low back wall
rules.about: Every room is a tile the slab's thickness deep: its front and right sides show, in two steps of the line colours, so the tiles read as solid. A low wall runs along the back and left edges, like a dolls house with the front taken off.

rules.title: Flat fills from the colour tokens
rules.about: Tops are the surface colour with a line-hi hairline; rooms the robot can't clean are the canvas with a line hairline. Picked rooms fill with accent-dim and an accent edge; the room it's cleaning now gets the accent edge. The dock is steel.

rules.title: Labels only where you can act
rules.about: Only rooms the robot cleans carry a name, in the caps label type, text-dim, centred on the room's label point; a picked room's name turns text (the accent-dim fill and edge carry the pick; accent-text would be under 4.5:1 on it). Rooms it doesn't clean (a utility room, a cloakroom) stay quiet.

rules.title: The robot is the only thing that moves
rules.about: Drawn at twice its real size so it reads: a short cylinder with its LiDAR turret, accent while it cleans. It glides to each new position (linear, the time between position reports) and its last run's path trails behind it.

rules.title: Cheap on the panel
rules.about: One image per theme, redrawn only where a room changes (a pick, the room it's in); the robot sprite moves with an animation. No live 3D per frame.

geometry.about: metres: tile thickness (slab), back wall height, the robot drawn at 2x its 0.35 m (radius 0.3, height 0.14), the LiDAR turret as a share of its top, its real radius (docked, it parks that far in front of the dock)

opacity.about: percent, mixed into the colour under it when the image is drawn (one solid RGB565 value per pixel, never a live blend)

generate.about: the floor plan generator (core/floorplan_auto.cpp, fw::fp::gen::), metres unless noted. grid = every corner lands on it; gap = the line between two rooms; straighten = edges shorter than this fold into one straight wall; align = room edges this close become one line; smooth = notches this small are closed; trim = bumps this narrow are cut; min-room (m2) = smaller pieces are not rooms; doorway / spill (m2) / spill-keep (%) = floor that leaked through an opening this wide, a piece this big, while the room keeps this share, is cut and reported; wall-reach / wall-cover (%) = a side moves out to a wall the vacuum saw within reach that runs along this share of it (furniture hides floor, not walls); spare-min (m2) / spare-trim = space left inside the house becomes a proposed room when this big, slivers this thin dropped; seal / speck = gaps this small in the house outline are closed and specks this small dropped before rooms are traced; map-px = a vacuum map pixel when the source doesn't say; dock = the dock's footprint side

motion.about: the robot's glide to a new position: linear over the position sensor's report interval (lab 2 s)
